ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels dominating the visible ventral surface against low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized at the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid white contiguous region across both visible lobes. Discrete low-intensity circular focal spots are mapped near the median notch on the right lobe surface. A continuous low-intensity band follows the trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with sharp pixel-peaks and narrow valleys along the entire visible trailing edge, showing highest amplitude at the mid-lobe sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed along the upper boundary of both the left and right lobes as they extend toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast, dark, irregular clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of at least two distinct dark circular focal marks near the median notch and significant encrustation-style clusters at the lateral extremities.
